DiffDialog.DescriptionText: The following changes were detected between your current load order and the reference:
DiffDialog.MultipleChangesHelp: There are a lot of changes in the list, including replacements and removals. This can confuse the change detection - If you made these edits, it is recommended to accept the changes. Otherwise, consider discarding the changes.
DiffDialog.ConfirmDiscardMessage:
You are about to discard all changes and restore Plugins.txt from the reference file.

This action cannot be undone. Are you sure you want to continue?
DiffDialog.ConfirmUpdateMessage:
You are about to update the reference file with the current Plugins.txt.

This will mark the current changes as accepted and create a new version in the history.

Are you sure you want to continue?
DiffDialog.DebugStateCopiedMessage:
The debug state has been successfully copied to your clipboard in JSON format.

You can now paste this information to share with developers for troubleshooting.
DiffDialog.FailedToCopyError: Failed to copy debug state to clipboard
DiffDialog.SortingInsertedWarning: IMPORTANT: Mods were inserted in the middle of the load order. Sort the list first to move them to the end before making other changes.

ProfileProperties.LabelTooShortError: Label must be at least 2 characters.
ProfileProperties.LabelDuplicateError: A profile with this label already exists.

SwitchProfile.DescriptionText: Select a profile to switch to:

ViewPendingChanges.ExplanationText: This shows all changes you have made since the last reference update. When you next update the reference file, these changes will be archived.

Common.ConfigInvalidGuidance: The likely cause is that the current configuration is invalid. Please refer to the error message in the main window to fix this.
Common.ProfilesFolderRequired: The application requires a 'Profiles' folder in your configured app data path to store profile data. This folder could not be created or accessed. Please check folder permissions or select a different app data path in settings.
Common.ProfilesFolderAccessDenied: Access denied when creating the Profiles folder. You may need administrator rights or to choose a different location.
Common.PluginsTxtRequired: The Plugins.txt file was not found in the configured app data path. This file is required for the application to function. Please ensure you have run Starfield at least once to generate this file, or select the correct app data folder in settings.

StatusCoordinator.ConfigRequired: Configuration is required. Please set paths in the Settings window.

FileMonitoring.SteamWarningTooltip: Steam is not running. SFSE requires Steam to be open to function correctly.
